name: Do you handle cabinet removal before installing new ones?

mainEntity.name: Do you handle cabinet removal before installing new ones?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, as part of our comprehensive cabinet installation service, we can handle the removal and disposal of your old cabinets. This ensures a seamless transition to your new cabinetry and saves you the effort of managing the old materials yourself. Please mention this requirement during your initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, we handle the removal and disposal of old cabinets as part of our installation service.
